name: Variant Human
short: A human who trades broad talent for one sharp gift: a feat at 1st level.
traitsShort: Two +1 scores of your choice; one skill; one feat at 1st level

profile.age: Adult by the late teens; most live under a century.
profile.desc: Variant humans look like any other human. The difference is in training: they have honed one special talent early in life. In play they are simple and flexible. The starting feat lets you build almost any idea from level 1.
profile.vestige: Most come from the Human Realm, though humans now live in many realms. Treat them as any human of Vestige who stands out early.
traits: Two different ability scores of your choice each rise by 1. The STR and DEX bonus shown here is a placeholder; move them where you like.
You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.
You gain one feat of your choice at 1st level.

name: Custom Lineage
short: Build your own people: one big score boost, a feat, and a sense or skill.
traitsShort: +2 to one score; one feat; darkvision or one skill; Small or Medium

profile.age: Lifespan matches a human unless your story says otherwise.
profile.senses: Darkvision 60 ft if chosen as the variable trait
profile.desc: A custom lineage is a frame for a people the books do not cover. You describe the look and the culture yourself. It may be a strange blend, a lone survivor, or something changed by magic. It plays like a variant human with a stronger single boost.
profile.vestige: Use this for a people you and your GM invent for one realm of Vestige. Keep its lore small and agreed at the table.
traits: One ability score of your choice rises by 2. The CON bonus shown here is a placeholder.
You gain one feat of your choice at 1st level.
Choose one: darkvision out to 60 feet, or proficiency in one skill of your choice.

name: Chromatic Dragonborn
short: A dragonborn whose blood carries a chromatic dragon's fury.
traitsShort: Line breath weapon; resists ancestry damage; brief immunity at 5th level

profile.age: Grow fast and reach adulthood by 15; most live to about 80.
profile.desc: Chromatic dragonborn have scales in the hard colors of their ancestors: black, blue, green, red, or white. Many feel a pull toward pride and power. Others fight that pull hard. They are strong front-line fighters with a long ranged breath.
profile.vestige: They might be found anywhere dragons left a mark, often near Chaos or Abyss borders. Their tie to any one dragon is personal, not a nation.
traits: Pick black (acid), blue (lightning), green (poison), red (fire), or white (cold). This sets your breath and resistance.

When you take the Attack action, you can swap one attack for a breath of your ancestry's damage in a 5-foot-wide, 30-foot line. Each creature there makes a Dex save (DC 8 + your CON modifier + proficiency bonus), taking 1d10 on a fail or half on a success. Damage rises to 2d10 at 5th level, 3d10 at 11th, and 4d10 at 17th. Uses equal your proficiency bonus per long rest.
You resist the damage type of your ancestry.
From 5th level, you can use an action to become immune to your ancestry damage for 1 minute. Once per long rest.

name: Metallic Dragonborn
short: A dragonborn shaped by a metallic dragon's calm and old strength.
traitsShort: Cone breath weapon; resists ancestry damage; second breath at 5th level

profile.age: Grow fast and reach adulthood by 15; most live to about 80.
profile.desc: Metallic dragonborn shine with brass, bronze, copper, gold, or silver scales. They often carry a sense of duty or curiosity. They are steady allies with a short, wide breath. At 5th level they gain a breath that controls the fight instead of dealing damage.
profile.vestige: They fit well in Heaven or the Human Realm, where order is prized. Any tie to an actual dragon is the player's own story.
traits: Pick brass (fire), bronze (lightning), copper (acid), gold (fire), or silver (cold). This sets your breath and resistance.

When you take the Attack action, you can swap one attack for a breath of your ancestry's damage in a 15-foot cone. Each creature there makes a Dex save (DC 8 + your CON modifier + proficiency bonus), taking 1d10 on a fail or half on a success. Damage rises to 2d10 at 5th level, 3d10 at 11th, and 4d10 at 17th. Uses equal your proficiency bonus per long rest.
You resist the damage type of your ancestry.

From 5th level, once per long rest you can exhale a second 15-foot cone. Enervating breath: a failed Con save leaves each target incapacitated until the start of your next turn. Repulsion breath: a failed Str save pushes each target 20 feet away and knocks it prone. Same DC as your Breath Weapon.

name: Gem Dragonborn
short: A dragonborn touched by a gem dragon's mind magic.
traitsShort: Cone breath weapon; resists ancestry damage; telepathy; short flight at 5th level

profile.age: Grow fast and reach adulthood by 15; most live to about 80.
profile.desc: Gem dragonborn have scales that look cut from crystal or stone. Their thoughts reach out to others without words. Many are thoughtful and inward. They play well as clever scouts and talkers with a rare breath type.
profile.vestige: Gem dragons are linked to the mind and to the far planes, so these dragonborn suit the Mysterious Realm or the Outer Realm. Keep their origins vague.
traits: Pick amethyst (force), crystal (radiant), emerald (psychic), sapphire (thunder), or topaz (necrotic). This sets your breath and resistance.

When you take the Attack action, you can swap one attack for a breath of your ancestry's damage in a 15-foot cone. Each creature there makes a Dex save (DC 8 + your CON modifier + proficiency bonus), taking 1d10 on a fail or half on a success. Damage rises to 2d10 at 5th level, 3d10 at 11th, and 4d10 at 17th. Uses equal your proficiency bonus per long rest.
You resist the damage type of your ancestry.
You can speak telepathically to any creature within 30 feet. It must know a language to understand you, and it cannot reply this way.
From 5th level, you can use a bonus action to grow spectral wings for 1 minute, gaining a fly speed equal to your walking speed. Once per long rest.

name: Draconblood Dragonborn
short: A hornless, tail-swinging dragonborn of old noble blood and sharp wits.
traitsShort: Darkvision; breath weapon; once-per-rest advantage on Intimidation or Persuasion

profile.age: Grow fast and reach adulthood by 15; most live to about 80.
profile.desc: Draconblood dragonborn have tails and lack the heavy build of other dragonborn. They see their bloodline as a mark of rank. They are confident and clever, and they like to lead. They make strong talkers and spellcasters.
profile.vestige: They suit old noble houses in the Human Realm or Inner Realm. Their pride in blood can be a story hook, not a fixed history.
traits: Pick a dragon type and its damage: black or copper (acid), blue or bronze (lightning), brass, gold, or red (fire), green (poison), silver or white (cold).

As an action, you breathe your ancestry's damage: a 5 by 30 foot line for acid, fire (brass), or lightning; a 15-foot cone for the rest. Dex or Con save as the type requires (DC 8 + your CON modifier + proficiency bonus). 2d6 on a fail, half on a success. Rises to 3d6 at 6th level, 4d6 at 11th, 5d6 at 16th. Once per short or long rest.
You see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You see only shades of gray in darkness.
Once per short or long rest, you can give yourself advantage on an Intimidation or Persuasion check.

name: Ravenite Dragonborn
short: A tough dragonborn who strikes back the moment it is hurt.
traitsShort: Darkvision; breath weapon; reaction attack when struck once per rest

profile.age: Grow fast and reach adulthood by 15; most live to about 80.
profile.desc: Ravenite dragonborn are broad, scarred, and hard to break. Many come from a past of labor or hardship they fought free of. They are proud of their own strength. In play they are sturdy fighters who punish anyone who hits them.
profile.vestige: They fit realms with hard frontiers, such as the Inner Void or the edges of Chaos. Their freedom story is theirs to shape.
traits: Pick a dragon type and its damage: black or copper (acid), blue or bronze (lightning), brass, gold, or red (fire), green (poison), silver or white (cold).

As an action, you breathe your ancestry's damage: a 5 by 30 foot line for acid, fire (brass), or lightning; a 15-foot cone for the rest. Dex or Con save as the type requires (DC 8 + your CON modifier + proficiency bonus). 2d6 on a fail, half on a success. Rises to 3d6 at 6th level, 4d6 at 11th, 5d6 at 16th. Once per short or long rest.
You see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You see only shades of gray in darkness.
When a creature in reach damages you, you can use your reaction to make one weapon attack against it. Once per short or long rest.

name: Abyssal Tiefling
short: A tiefling marked by the wild, rotting power of demons.
traitsShort: Darkvision; resists poison; poison spells; thaumaturgy

profile.age: Mature at the same rate as humans and live a little longer.
profile.desc: Abyssal tieflings show demonic signs: odd horns, rough skin, or eyes that glow. Their power is unruly and sickly. Many are restless and blunt. They play as hardy casters who weaken foes.
profile.vestige: They are tied to the Abyss realm by blood, not by loyalty. Most never set foot there.
traits: You see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You see only shades of gray in darkness.
You have resistance to poison damage.
You know Poison Spray. At 3rd level you can cast Ray of Sickness, and at 5th Hold Person, each once per long rest without a slot (or with slots as normal). Choose INT, WIS, or CHA for these spells.
You know the Thaumaturgy cantrip, using the same ability as your legacy spells.

name: Chthonic Tiefling
short: A tiefling marked by the cold, grave-deep power of the underworld.
traitsShort: Darkvision; resists necrotic; death-touched spells; thaumaturgy

profile.age: Mature at the same rate as humans and live a little longer.
profile.desc: Chthonic tieflings carry the chill of the dead. Their skin may be ashen and their touch cold. Many are quiet and patient. They play as grim casters who drain foes and pad their own health.
profile.vestige: Their legacy points to deep, dead places such as the Void or Inner Void. That tie is distant and personal.
traits: You see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You see only shades of gray in darkness.
You have resistance to necrotic damage.
You know Chill Touch. At 3rd level you can cast False Life, and at 5th Ray of Enfeeblement, each once per long rest without a slot (or with slots as normal). Choose INT, WIS, or CHA for these spells.
You know the Thaumaturgy cantrip, using the same ability as your legacy spells.

name: Feral Tiefling
short: A quick, sharp tiefling with a hunter's edge instead of a talker's charm.
traitsShort: Darkvision; resists fire; thaumaturgy, hellish rebuke, darkness

profile.age: Mature at the same rate as humans and live a little longer.
profile.desc: Feral tieflings look like other tieflings but move with a lean, fast grace. They lean on speed and brains over charm. Many feel more wild than refined. They suit rogues, rangers, and quick arcane casters.
profile.vestige: They fit anywhere Hell's blood has touched the mortal realms. Treat the hellish link as old and faint.
traits: You see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You see only shades of gray in darkness.
You have resistance to fire damage.
You know Thaumaturgy. At 3rd level you can cast Hellish Rebuke as a 2nd-level spell once per long rest, and at 5th Darkness once per long rest. CHA is your spellcasting ability.

name: Winged Tiefling
short: A tiefling born with leathery wings instead of hellish spells.
traitsShort: Darkvision; resists fire; bat-like wings with a 30-foot fly speed

profile.age: Mature at the same rate as humans and live a little longer.
profile.desc: Winged tieflings bear leathery wings that fold behind them like a cloak. They draw stares even among other tieflings. Flight shapes how they see the world: from above, with an easy way out. They are great scouts and skirmishers.
profile.vestige: Hell's blood shows plainly in them. In Vestige they may face suspicion in Heaven but find work as messengers or scouts.
traits: You see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You see only shades of gray in darkness.
You have resistance to fire damage.
You have bat-like wings that grow from your shoulders. You have a flying speed of 30 feet while not wearing heavy armor. These wings replace the usual Infernal Legacy spells.

name: Infernal Tiefling
short: A tiefling whose power comes straight from the fires of the Nine Hells.
traitsShort: Darkvision; resists fire; fire bolt, hellish rebuke, darkness

profile.age: Mature at the same rate as humans and live a little longer.
profile.desc: Infernal tieflings are the newer, 2024 take on the classic tiefling. Horns, tails, and solid-colored eyes are common. Their legacy is fire and shadow. They play as flexible casters with a strong damage cantrip.
profile.vestige: They trace their spark to Hell, one of Vestige's eleven realms. Most live far from it and owe it nothing.
traits: You see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You see only shades of gray in darkness.
You have resistance to fire damage.
You know Fire Bolt. At 3rd level you can cast Hellish Rebuke, and at 5th Darkness, each once per long rest without a slot (or with slots as normal). Choose INT, WIS, or CHA for these spells.
You know the Thaumaturgy cantrip, using the same ability as your legacy spells.

name: Tiefling of Baalzebul
short: A tiefling whose bloodline traces back to the archdevil Baalzebul.
traitsShort: Darkvision; resists fire; thaumaturgy, ray of sickness, crown of madness

profile.age: Mature at the same rate as humans and live a little longer.
profile.desc: These tieflings carry the mark of Baalzebul, an archdevil of lies and slow corruption. Their faces can look sly or swollen, and some smell faintly of rot. They are not bound to serve their patron, but the link shapes their gifts. They play as tieflings with a different spell kit and a different stat lean.
profile.vestige: In Vestige, Baalzebul is best treated as a distant power of Hell. A character's bloodline is a family secret, not a pact.
traits: You see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You see only shades of gray in darkness.
You have resistance to fire damage.
You know Thaumaturgy. At 3rd level you can cast Ray of Sickness as a 2nd-level spell once per long rest, and at 5th Crown of Madness once per long rest. CHA is your spellcasting ability.

name: Tiefling of Dispater
short: A tiefling whose bloodline traces back to the archdevil Dispater.
traitsShort: Darkvision; resists fire; thaumaturgy, disguise self, detect thoughts

profile.age: Mature at the same rate as humans and live a little longer.
profile.desc: These tieflings carry the mark of Dispater, an archdevil of secrets and locked doors. They often look plain and watchful, with iron-gray coloring. They are not bound to serve their patron, but the link shapes their gifts. They play as tieflings with a different spell kit and a different stat lean.
profile.vestige: In Vestige, Dispater is best treated as a distant power of Hell. A character's bloodline is a family secret, not a pact.
traits: You see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You see only shades of gray in darkness.
You have resistance to fire damage.
You know Thaumaturgy. At 3rd level you can cast Disguise Self once per long rest, and at 5th Detect Thoughts once per long rest. CHA is your spellcasting ability.

name: Tiefling of Fierna
short: A tiefling whose bloodline traces back to the archdevil Fierna.
traitsShort: Darkvision; resists fire; friends, charm person, suggestion

profile.age: Mature at the same rate as humans and live a little longer.
profile.desc: These tieflings carry the mark of Fierna, an archdevil of passion and charm. They are often striking and warm, with red or golden tones. They are not bound to serve their patron, but the link shapes their gifts. They play as tieflings with a different spell kit and a different stat lean.
profile.vestige: In Vestige, Fierna is best treated as a distant power of Hell. A character's bloodline is a family secret, not a pact.
traits: You see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You see only shades of gray in darkness.
You have resistance to fire damage.
You know Friends. At 3rd level you can cast Charm Person as a 2nd-level spell once per long rest, and at 5th Suggestion once per long rest. CHA is your spellcasting ability.

name: Tiefling of Glasya
short: A tiefling whose bloodline traces back to the archdevil Glasya.
traitsShort: Darkvision; resists fire; minor illusion, disguise self, invisibility

profile.age: Mature at the same rate as humans and live a little longer.
profile.desc: These tieflings carry the mark of Glasya, an archdevil of schemes and clever crime. They tend to be slim and quick, with sharp, bright eyes. They are not bound to serve their patron, but the link shapes their gifts. They play as tieflings with a different spell kit and a different stat lean.
profile.vestige: In Vestige, Glasya is best treated as a distant power of Hell. A character's bloodline is a family secret, not a pact.
traits: You see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You see only shades of gray in darkness.
You have resistance to fire damage.
You know Minor Illusion. At 3rd level you can cast Disguise Self once per long rest, and at 5th Invisibility once per long rest. CHA is your spellcasting ability.

name: Tiefling of Levistus
short: A tiefling whose bloodline traces back to the archdevil Levistus.
traitsShort: Darkvision; resists fire; ray of frost, armor of agathys, darkness

profile.age: Mature at the same rate as humans and live a little longer.
profile.desc: These tieflings carry the mark of Levistus, an archdevil of cold and grim endurance. Their skin may be pale blue and cool to the touch. They are not bound to serve their patron, but the link shapes their gifts. They play as tieflings with a different spell kit and a different stat lean.
profile.vestige: In Vestige, Levistus is best treated as a distant power of Hell. A character's bloodline is a family secret, not a pact.
traits: You see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You see only shades of gray in darkness.
You have resistance to fire damage.
You know Ray of Frost. At 3rd level you can cast Armor of Agathys as a 2nd-level spell once per long rest, and at 5th Darkness once per long rest. CHA is your spellcasting ability.

name: Tiefling of Mammon
short: A tiefling whose bloodline traces back to the archdevil Mammon.
traitsShort: Darkvision; resists fire; mage hand, tenser's floating disk, arcane lock

profile.age: Mature at the same rate as humans and live a little longer.
profile.desc: These tieflings carry the mark of Mammon, an archdevil of wealth and greed. Many have a gold sheen to their skin or eyes. They are not bound to serve their patron, but the link shapes their gifts. They play as tieflings with a different spell kit and a different stat lean.
profile.vestige: In Vestige, Mammon is best treated as a distant power of Hell. A character's bloodline is a family secret, not a pact.
traits: You see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You see only shades of gray in darkness.
You have resistance to fire damage.
You know Mage Hand. At 3rd level you can cast Tenser's Floating Disk once per long rest, and at 5th Arcane Lock once per long rest. CHA is your spellcasting ability.

name: Tiefling of Mephistopheles
short: A tiefling whose bloodline traces back to the archdevil Mephistopheles.
traitsShort: Darkvision; resists fire; mage hand, burning hands, flame blade

profile.age: Mature at the same rate as humans and live a little longer.
profile.desc: These tieflings carry the mark of Mephistopheles, an archdevil of arcane fire and forbidden lore. Their horns often curl high and their eyes flicker like flame. They are not bound to serve their patron, but the link shapes their gifts. They play as tieflings with a different spell kit and a different stat lean.
profile.vestige: In Vestige, Mephistopheles is best treated as a distant power of Hell. A character's bloodline is a family secret, not a pact.
traits: You see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You see only shades of gray in darkness.
You have resistance to fire damage.
You know Mage Hand. At 3rd level you can cast Burning Hands as a 2nd-level spell once per long rest, and at 5th Flame Blade once per long rest. CHA is your spellcasting ability.

name: Tiefling of Zariel
short: A tiefling whose bloodline traces back to the archdevil Zariel.
traitsShort: Darkvision; resists fire; thaumaturgy, searing smite, branding smite

profile.age: Mature at the same rate as humans and live a little longer.
profile.desc: These tieflings carry the mark of Zariel, an archdevil of war and fury. They are often tall and scarred, with ember-bright eyes. They are not bound to serve their patron, but the link shapes their gifts. They play as tieflings with a different spell kit and a different stat lean.
profile.vestige: In Vestige, Zariel is best treated as a distant power of Hell. A character's bloodline is a family secret, not a pact.
traits: You see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You see only shades of gray in darkness.
You have resistance to fire damage.
You know Thaumaturgy. At 3rd level you can cast Searing Smite as a 2nd-level spell once per long rest, and at 5th Branding Smite once per long rest. CHA is your spellcasting ability.

name: Ghostwise Halfling
short: A reclusive wild halfling who can speak mind to mind.
traitsShort: Lucky; brave; nimble; short-range telepathy

profile.age: Adult at 20; many live to 150.
profile.desc: Ghostwise halflings live deep in forests, apart from other folk. They are quiet and close-knit. Their silent speech lets them hunt and plan without a sound. They play as calm, wary scouts.
profile.vestige: They fit wild, quiet corners of the Human Realm or the Mysterious Realm. Few outsiders know their homes.
traits: When you roll a 1 on a d20 for an attack, ability check, or save, you can reroll it and must use the new roll.
You have advantage on saves against being frightened.
You can move through the space of any creature that is at least one size larger than you.
You can speak telepathically to one creature within 30 feet. It must share a language with you to understand. It cannot answer this way.

name: Lotusden Halfling
short: A forest halfling who draws plant magic from the woods it guards.
traitsShort: Lucky; brave; nimble; druidcraft, entangle, spike growth; hard to track

profile.age: Adult at 20; many live to 150.
profile.desc: Lotusden halflings live within a great, wild forest and treat it as kin. Moss, bark, and flowers often decorate them. They are gentle until their home is threatened. They play as nature casters who control the ground.
profile.vestige: They suit the deep green places of the Human Realm or the Primordial realm. Keep their forest homes small and local.
traits: When you roll a 1 on a d20 for an attack, ability check, or save, you can reroll it and must use the new roll.
You have advantage on saves against being frightened.
You can move through the space of any creature that is at least one size larger than you.
You know Druidcraft. At 3rd level you can cast Entangle, and at 5th Spike Growth, each once per long rest without components. WIS is your spellcasting ability.
Checks to track you have disadvantage. Moving through nonmagical difficult terrain made of plants and undergrowth costs you no extra movement.

name: Pallid Elf
short: A pale, moon-blessed elf with a gift for seeing hidden truths.
traitsShort: Darkvision; keen senses; fey ancestry; trance; sharp insight; moon magic

profile.age: Adult around 100; may live to 750.
profile.desc: Pallid elves have very pale skin and white or silver hair. They live by the moon and value hidden knowledge. Many are calm, probing, and hard to fool. They make strong investigators and support casters.
profile.vestige: They suit quiet, moonlit places in the Mysterious Realm. Their faith in the moon can be a small local custom.
traits: You see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You see only shades of gray in darkness.
You are proficient in the Perception skill.
You have advantage on saves against being charmed, and magic cannot put you to sleep.
You do not sleep. Four hours of light meditation gives you the same benefit as eight hours of sleep.
You have advantage on Investigation and Insight checks.
You know Light. At 3rd level you can cast Sleep, and at 5th Invisibility (self only), each once per long rest without components. WIS is your spellcasting ability.

name: Aquatic Half-Elf
short: A half-elf with sea elf blood who swims as well as it walks.
traitsShort: Darkvision; fey ancestry; 30-foot swim speed

profile.age: Adult around 20; may live past 180.
profile.desc: Aquatic half-elves have one parent of sea elf descent. They often grow up in coastal towns between two worlds. Many are easy-going and good at making friends on both shores. They play as charming, flexible heroes at home in water.
profile.vestige: They fit port cities and coasts in the Human Realm. Their sea-elf kin may be a story of their own.
traits: You see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You see only shades of gray in darkness.
You have advantage on saves against being charmed, and magic cannot put you to sleep.
CHA rises by 2 and two other scores of your choice rise by 1. CON is shown as a placeholder.
You have a swimming speed of 30 feet. This replaces the usual half-elf Skill Versatility.

name: Kender
short: A small, fearless wanderer with a sharp tongue and curious hands.
traitsShort: Fearless; one wanderer skill; taunt foes into attacking you

profile.age: Adult around 20; most live about 100 years.
profile.desc: Kender look like slim, quick halflings with long topknots and bright eyes. They are endlessly curious and rarely afraid. Objects tend to "find their way" into their pockets. They play as bold, chatty tricksters who pull attention off their friends.
profile.vestige: Kender suit the roads between realms, where their wanderlust takes them. They rarely stay in one realm long.
traits: You have advantage on saves against being frightened. Once per long rest, when you fail such a save, you can succeed instead.
You gain proficiency in one of these skills: Insight, Investigation, Sleight of Hand, Stealth, or Survival.

As a bonus action, pick a creature within 60 feet that can hear you. It makes a WIS save (DC 8 + proficiency bonus + your INT, WIS, or CHA modifier). On a fail, it has disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you until the start of your next turn. Uses equal your proficiency bonus per long rest.

name: Aetherborn
short: A short-lived being born from refined aether, grey-skinned and driven.
traitsShort: Darkvision; resists necrotic; proficient in Intimidation

profile.age: Born fully grown; few live more than a few years.
profile.desc: Aetherborn have ash-gray skin and dark eyes, and they seem to fade at the edges. They come into being as adults and know their lives are short. Many chase pleasure, fame, or a lasting legacy. They play as bold, eerie talkers.
profile.vestige: Their sudden birth from pure energy fits the Inner Realm or the Primordial realm. How they first appeared is left open.
traits: You see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You see only shades of gray in darkness.
CHA rises by 2 and two other scores of your choice rise by 1. DEX is shown as a placeholder.
You have resistance to necrotic damage.
You are proficient in the Intimidation skill.

name: Kor
short: A lean nomad who climbs cliffs and crosses chasms with rope and hook.
traitsShort: Climb speed 30; Athletics and Acrobatics; lucky

profile.age: Adult by 20; live about as long as humans.
profile.desc: Kor are tall and slender with pale skin and long limbs. They travel light and live as nomads. Ropes and hooks are their tools and their art. They play as agile climbers and quiet, steady guides.
profile.vestige: Kor suit wild, broken lands in the Primordial realm or along the edges of the Void. They tend to pass through rather than settle.
traits: You have a climbing speed of 30 feet. You are proficient in Athletics and Acrobatics.
When you roll a 1 on a d20 for an attack, ability check, or save, you can reroll it and must use the new roll.
You can share simple ideas with other kor through hand signs, silently.

name: Merfolk
short: A sea dweller with a fish-like body who walks the land as well as it swims.
traitsShort: Amphibious; swim speed 30; one lore skill

profile.age: Adult by 18; live about as long as humans.
profile.desc: Merfolk have fins, fine scales, and skin in shades of blue, green, or gray. They can walk on land but feel most at home in water. Many follow a creed that shapes their outlook. They play as graceful, thoughtful explorers.
profile.vestige: Merfolk fit the seas and rivers of any realm, especially the Human Realm's coasts. Their creeds are local beliefs, not world lore.
traits: You can breathe both air and water.
You have a swimming speed of 30 feet.
You gain proficiency in one of these skills: Insight, Nature, or Persuasion.

name: Siren
short: A winged, bird-like sea folk with a voice that sways listeners.
traitsShort: Fly speed 30; friends cantrip

profile.age: Adult by 18; live about as long as humans.
profile.desc: Sirens have feathers, wings, and bright eyes, and many live near the sea. Their voices are their pride. They often work as guides, pirates, or messengers. They play as fast flyers and smooth talkers.
